description: Fixed offline workload catalogue for repeatable research-control-plane evaluation. Scenarios are test conditions, not market observations.

evaluation_limits.runtime_invocations: Only coordinator-observed process or thread events count; offline fixture evaluation reports zero live invocations.
evaluation_limits.token_usage: Measured only from actual runtime usage telemetry; never estimated from text length.
evaluation_limits.single_vs_multi: Compare only paired runs over identical workload IDs and start-state hashes. Synthetic/simulated roles do not count as native delegation.
evaluation_limits.historical_outcomes: Use the append-only accountability ledger; absence of a ledger means unavailable, not zero performance.
